Capital at risk

Historical simulations may differ materially from live trading. No outcome is guaranteed.

narrative.overview: A nocturnal instrument room built to examine markets rather than sell a fantasy about them. Midnight surfaces hold steel measurement lines, paper-white conclusions, and a single red decision signal; motion reads as observation, not spectacle.
keyCharacteristics: Bold Manrope with DM Mono readouts

rules.name: The Flat Instrument Rule
rules.body: Use tone, border, crop, and scale before shadow.

rules.name: The Read Order Rule
rules.body: Responsive collapse preserves assertion, context, evidence, implication, and action.

dos: Do present evidence, limitations, and risk beside performance and purchase actions.
Do use red only for action, active signal, plotted emphasis, or real risk status.
Do keep every message understandable with animation disabled.
donts: Don't use generic rounded cards, decorative pills, or repeated kicker-above-headline formulas.
Don't separate return from drawdown or historical-simulation limits.
Don't use animation as spectacle or as the sole carrier of meaning.
